summary: This standards-track document extends IKEv2 so a peer can quickly detect that its partner has restarted and lost the tunnel state. A saved token allows detection in much less time than the normal route, which can take minutes.

eli5.summary: If one side forgets the secret handshake after rebooting, it gets quickly noticed using a token, rather than waiting a long time.

questions: how to detect ipsec peer reboot
